categories.main_business_segments: Hunan Zhongke Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: lithium-ion battery anode materials and magnetic-electric equipment. The lithium battery segment focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery anode materials used in new energy vehicles, energy storage, and consumer electronics. The magnetic-electric equipment segment manufactures electromagnetic metallurgy equipment, industrial magnetic devices, and lithium battery-specific equipment, serving industries such as steel, transportation, shipbuilding, machinery, mining, and lithium batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced graphite processing technologies, heat treatment, and graphite composite techniques for anode materials, including proprietary fully automated intelligent graphitization furnaces that reduce energy consumption and improve automation and environmental performance. It also develops silicon-carbon and hard carbon anode materials with enhanced electrochemical properties. In magnetic-electric equipment, it utilizes electromagnetic metallurgy technology, magnetic separation, electrical automation control, numerical simulation, and engineering applications. The company maintains strong R&D capabilities with numerous patents and collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL, BYD, CALB, EVE Energy, Ruipu Lanjun, Honeycomb Energy, ATL, LGES, SK On, and Samsung SDI. The end markets served are primarily new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, and consumer digital products. The magnetic-electric equipment segment serves major steel enterprises, large metallurgical engineering contractors, and industrial sectors including steel, transportation, shipbuilding, and mining.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases and subsidiaries in Hunan, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, and Anhui provinces. It also has plans for overseas production facilities to support international market expansion. Sales are concentrated in the East China region, followed by South China, Southwest China, North China, Northwest China, Northeast China, and overseas markets, with overseas sales accounting for a smaller portion but targeted for growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hunan Zhongke Electric operates primarily upstream and midstream in the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on the production of key anode materials and manufacturing of specialized equipment for battery production. It integrates raw material sourcing, processing, and equipment manufacturing, positioning itself as a critical supplier to battery manufacturers and steel producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in lithium battery anode materials, focusing on high-performance graphite, silicon-carbon composites, and hard carbon materials to meet fast-charging, high-energy-density, and long-life requirements. It invests in developing new products for energy storage and consumer electronics markets. In magnetic-electric equipment, it aims to deepen electromagnetic metallurgy technology, expand applications across steel and non-ferrous metals, and enhance lithium battery equipment capabilities. The company pursues internationalization, supply chain optimization, and green, intelligent manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion battery anode materials and magnetic-electric equipment. The company follows an order-based production model with some inventory for market forecasting. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial asset management. Sales are predominantly direct to large customers in the battery and steel industries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the lithium battery anode materials sector, competitors include BTR, Shanghai Shanshan, Jiangxi Zichen, and Shangtai Technology. Hunan Zhongke Electric is among the earliest entrants with strong technological and first-mover advantages, ranking third in global anode material shipments. In electromagnetic metallurgy equipment, it competes with international firms like ABB and Danieli-Rotelec and domestic companies such as Kemetda and Longi. The company holds a leading domestic market share exceeding 60% in continuous casting EMS systems, positioning it as a domestic industry leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.58 billion, a 13.72% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 303 million, a significant increase of 626.56%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 11.33 billion, growing 9.27% from the previous year. The lithium battery materials segment accounts for over 93% of revenue, showing strong growth, while the magnetic-electric equipment segment maintains stable revenue. The company has a workforce of over 3,700 employees, with substantial R&D investment accounting for around 3.63% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies such as its fully automated intelligent graphitization furnace, enabling lower energy consumption and higher product quality. It offers a comprehensive product line with high-performance, fast-charging, and cost-effective anode materials tailored for diverse applications. Its magnetic-electric equipment benefits from integrated electromagnetic metallurgy expertise and strong engineering capabilities. The company’s extensive patent portfolio, strategic partnerships, and integrated supply chain enhance its competitive edge, enabling it to provide high-quality, innovative products with reliable customer service and international market reach.
